name: quadrupole-rf-unstable
description: Published: the tabulated Mathieu cut-off is q = 0.90804, and this model sits at q = 0.95. A round-rod quadrupole driven at 1 MHz with the RF amplitude set so that m/z 500 sits at a Mathieu q of 0.95, which is above the tabulated low-mass cut-off of q = 0.90804 on the a = 0 line. The ion does not. Run this beside its stable twin: together they bracket a published boundary, which is a stronger statement than either alone, and neither number comes from this engine. The amplitude is arithmetic - q = 4 z e V / (m Omega^2 r0^2) gives 777.4 V - so the operating point can be checked before any simulation runs.
